dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #How are we feeling, {NICKNAME}? Let's continue guiding the Ashas as they collect the paint balls!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Alright! It's always so exciting to be on an adventure with you!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Well, let me think...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: ..Because I was having such great luck in Natlan, I was able to explore things I hadn't dared to delve into before...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: For example, making myself a perfectly suited set of adventure gear! Wristguards, knee pads, leg wraps, and insoles — all included!

choices.text: Those are some rather unexpected items...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: #That's something you should also pay more attention to, {NICKNAME}. Protecting your joints and feet from injury is really important when you're on an adventure.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Climbing with a load puts your knees under constant stress. So when you're moving through rugged terrain, you've got to stay sure-footed — one wrong step, and you could easily twist an ankle.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: On longer hikes, your feet might give out before your legs do. You've got to guard against fatigue, or you might end up hurting yourself without even realizing it.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: That's when gear that cushions impact and protects you really comes in handy.

choices.text: You do have a point there.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: In the long run, you can never have too much handy gear!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: You might also be interested in some tips other adventurers have gathered through years of trial and error...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: For example, you can chop up plants like the Calla Lily and Saurian Claw Succulent, crush them into a flour, and cook the mixture with Unmoving Essential Oil for a couple of days.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Then, pour everything into a mold and let it cool next to the Mist Flower overnight. After that, just trim it lightly and shave off any uneven parts...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: And voilà, you've got protective gear that's even more shock-absorbing than the Prancing Mushrooms of Sumeru! They say with it on, you could climb the Great Volcano of Tollan twice in a day and your soles and joints would still be fine!

choices.text: That sounds like a pretty straightforward process to me.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: You know, if I were anywhere else, I'd probably find myself stuck at the cooking part...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Either something unknown gets mixed into the pot and the whole thing spoils halfway through, or the entire pot explodes and sends fragments flying everywhere...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: If I went shopping for something similar, I'd either end up with gear that doesn't fit me or something of poor quality.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Not that the seller is deliberately trying to sell me something inferior — rather, they might not even be aware of the quality issues themselves... I'd just have to chalk it up to bad luck in either case.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: That's why I've never had good protective gear before. While it's not exactly mission-critical, but it definitely affects how your adventure goes.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: So, I decided to get exactly what I need to finally make gear I'd be satisfied with during this trip to the resort...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: This feels so wonderful... So this is what it feels like to run with good insoles and knee pads that fit just right!

choices.text: Although I could probably climb the volcano a few times even without it...
I haven't really thought about that before.
Are there any of your other friends around here?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Well, if you mean the adventurer friends I've met before, they're all satisfied and have gone back home with my dads.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: The only ones left in Natlan are a few tourists from Mondstadt who rode in with us.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: But there was... I think a wrestler with horns on her head? She came up to me and asked if I'd seen a girl wearing a hat...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I heard that wrestler is some big-shot warrior from the Collective of Plenty who did pretty well at the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Maybe quite a few of those Mondstadters have made friends with the people of Natlan while we weren't looking...?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Alright, we'll be waiting for you!
